top_signals.title: Five crypto exchanges are helping Russia evade sanctions, filling Garantex's void: Elliptic
top_signals.summary: Five crypto exchanges are reportedly helping Russia evade sanctions, filling the void left by Garantex. One exchange processed at least $11 billion in crypto from the same building previously used by the sanctioned Garantex.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Heightened sanctions scrutiny on Russia-linked exchanges like ABCeX processing $11B risks broader regulatory crackdowns compressing valuations across CEX deal flow and exposing portfolio companies to compliance burdens.

top_signals.title: IoTeX hit by private key exploit draining up to $8.8 million from bridge contracts
top_signals.summary: IoTeX suffered a private key exploit that drained up to $8.8 million from its bridge contracts. The co-founder claims the actual losses are lower than initial estimates but hasn't provided a specific number.
top_signals.why_it_matters: IoTeX bridge exploit draining up to $8.8M underscores persistent private key vulnerabilities in cross-chain infrastructure eroding investor confidence and tightening funding for Layer 1/bridge protocols.

top_signals.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Post Five Consecutive Weeks of Outflows Reaching $3.8B
top_signals.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced their fifth consecutive week of outflows, totaling $315.9 million last week and reaching $3.8 billion over the five-week period. Despite these recent outflows, cumulative inflows since launch still exceed $54 billion, and Ether ETFs have also turned negative.
top_signals.why_it_matters: $3.8B Bitcoin ETF outflows signal institutional risk-off sentiment pressuring secondary market valuations and delaying fresh capital inflows into Web3 equity rounds.

top_signals.title: Done Deal: Nakamoto Closes $107M All-Stock Takeover of CEO David Bailey's BTC Inc. & UTXO
top_signals.summary: Nakamoto has completed its $107 million all-stock acquisition of BTC Inc. and UTXO, which was announced earlier this week. The deal involves CEO David Bailey's company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nakamoto's $107M all-stock acquisition of BTC Inc. and UTXO consolidates media and event infrastructure strengthening competitive positioning in Bitcoin ecosystem deal flow.

top_signals.title: Superstate Raises $82.5M to Scale Onchain Equity Issuance
top_signals.summary: Superstate raised $82.5M in a Series B round led by Bain Capital Crypto. The funding will be used to expand their services from tokenized Treasuries to SEC-registered equity issuance onchain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Superstate's $82.5M raise to scale SEC-registered onchain equity issuance accelerates RWA tokenization trends boosting infrastructure layer investments and normalizing hybrid TradFi-Web3 structures.
top_signals.related: Also reported by: William M. Peaster, Bankless

top_signals.why_it_matters: Thrive's $10B fundraise and Benchmark's Altman addition intensify VC competition for top Web3 deals elevating entry valuations while signaling sustained capital deployment into protocols.

worth_a_read.title: MiCA Compliance Momentum Builds with BSV Recognition and EBA Guidance
worth_a_read.note: BSV Association secured MiCA recognition on February 16, 2026, co-authoring a white paper to shape compliant blockchain standards for enterprises. The EBA issued guidance advising national authorities on post-March 2 actions for CASPs handling electronic money tokens under PSD2-MiCA interplay, with over 100 providers already applying. This aligns with Blockwall's European crypto regulation thesis, signaling a shift from pilots to production deployments. Forward-looking, full MiCA enforcement by mid-2026 will force non-compliant CASPs to exit, creating opportunities for licensed players in stablecoin rails and DeFi infrastructure.

worth_a_read.title: Tokenization Funding and Volume Surge Despite Regulatory Headwinds
worth_a_read.note: Superstate raised $82.5 million in Series B funding to scale onchain equity issuance beyond tokenized Treasuries, while Kraken's xStocks hit $25 billion in tokenized stock volume. BNP Paribas piloted Ethereum-based money market tokenization, and SEC leaders outlined an innovation exemption for tokenized securities. This ties directly to Blockwall's tokenization thesis, showing TradFi integration accelerating. Implication: Expect tokenized assets to capture private markets share, with $10-year wealth management forecasts predicting AI-driven portfolios and onchain access boosting adoption.

worth_a_read.title: Stablecoin Ecosystem Faces Illicit Pressures Amid ETF and Regulatory Clarity
worth_a_read.note: Illicit stablecoin activity hit a five-year high at $141 billion in 2025, with 86% sanctions-linked, while Tether USDT supply dropped $1.5 billion in February. Countering this, ProShares' stablecoin-ready ETF debuted with $17 billion volume, and SEC guidance allowed a 2% haircut on broker stablecoin positions. Relevant to Blockwall's stablecoin rails thesis, this highlights resilience amid misuse. Forward, MiCA's EMT rules and PSD2 transitions will standardize reserves, potentially channeling growth through compliant rails like those in Cyprus regulator terms.

worth_a_read.title: Prediction Markets Draw Heavy VC Bets Amid Global Regulatory Scrutiny
worth_a_read.note: Dragonfly Capital's $650 million fourth fund made early bets on Polymarket, while sports-focused Novig raised $75 million at $500 million valuation from Pantera and Multicoin to challenge Polymarket and Kalshi. Despite bearish signals like Dutch penalties on Polymarket and US insider trading bills, funding persists. This intersects Blockwall's DeFi infrastructure thesis via governance and liquidity innovations. Implication: Regulatory clarity under MiCA could legitimize these platforms, driving DeFi volume as Europe harmonizes rules by end-2026.

worth_a_read.title: Institutional Bitcoin Accumulation Persists Through ETF Outflows
worth_a_read.note: Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $3.8 billion in five-week outflows, yet Abu Dhabi funds bought $1 billion in BlackRock's IBIT, holding over $1 billion end-2025, and Microstrategy added 2,486 BTC for $168 million, reaching 717,131 BTC or 3.4% supply. Nakamoto's $107 million acquisition of BTC Inc. consolidates Bitcoin ventures. While not core to Blockwall theses, it supports wallet/identity via institutional custody trends. Forward, dip-buying signals resilience, potentially stabilizing rails for tokenization and DeFi as MiCA enables EU inflows.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Blockwall Capital's WEEKLY crypto digest analyzes 638 stories from February 16 to 22, 2026. This week underscores a maturing ecosystem where institutional ambition collides with persistent risks, from geopolitical maneuvering to infrastructure vulnerabilities. From a European VC lens, these developments signal selective opportunities amid volatility, as onchain finance scales while traditional products face outflows. Geopolitical tensions persist as five crypto exchanges step in to help Russia evade sanctions, filling the void left by Garantex. One platform processed at least $11 billion in crypto from the same building once used by the sanctioned entity. This highlights crypto's dual role as both innovation accelerator and regulatory flashpoint, demanding vigilant compliance for long-term viability. Security remains a core challenge. IoTeX endured a private key exploit draining up to $8.8 million from bridge contracts, though the co-founder insists actual losses fall below initial estimates. Such incidents reinforce our thesis: robust infrastructure protocols are foundational for Web3 adoption, echoing Blockwall's Asset Classification Framework that prioritizes secure layers. Market dynamics reveal cooling institutional fervor. Spot Bitcoin ETFs marked five straight weeks of outflows, with $315.9 million exiting last week and $3.8 billion over the period. Cumulative inflows since launch still top $54 billion, yet Ether ETFs have also dipped negative. Total stablecoin supply climbed 2.9% to $317.94 billion, underscoring resilient liquidity even as DeFi TVL holds at $311 billion. Amid headwinds, consolidation drives progress. Nakamoto sealed a $107 million all-stock takeover of BTC Inc. and UTXO, bolstering its ecosystem under CEO David Bailey. Superstate's $82.5 million Series B, led by Bain Capital Crypto, positions it to expand from tokenized Treasuries into SEC-registered onchain equity issuance. These moves exemplify convergence, blending TradFi instruments with programmable rails, a trend we at Blockwall champion for European founders building borderless capital markets. Forward-looking, expect regulatory scrutiny to sharpen focus on compliant innovators. What pivotal shift do you anticipate next week? #Web3 #Crypto #Blockchain #CryptoVC #WeeklyDigest
